thread:
Tess (Design): quick sync on the batch vectors inspector + export modal. trying to lock copy + a11y + small example header. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zzzz
Willa (Product): two asks: default compact rows for big lists, and an opt-in source_text column for rerank use cases. can default collapse threshold be 300 rows? :+1:
Vik (Eng): collapse default at >300 is fine. we'll virtualize at >500. note on exports: CSV for <=1k, JSONL.gz for >1k. background job for >10k with email/link.
Uma (A11y): a11y notes: toggle must have aria-expanded & aria-controls, expanded panel must receive focus, announce "N results loaded" with aria-live polite on load. export modal needs focus trap and Escape closes. When background job completes, send a role=alert notification with link.
Xia (QA): copy mismatch caught: modal title currently "Export embeddings" but CTA reads "Download CSV". pick one. also test CSV parse in Excel/Sheets and localized decimals.
Tess (Design): proposed copy:
- Title: "Export vectors"
- Helper: "Includes vector ids and scores. Toggle to include original source text (opt-in)."
- Checkbox: "Include original source text (opt-in)"
- Primary: "Download CSV"
- Example toggle: "Show example headers" (collapsed)
Is this okay?
Willa (Product): LGTM. add limit note: "Up to 10k vectors; larger exports run in background and you'll receive a link." Also add tiny privacy hint when source_text is checked: "Source text is included only in the downloaded file; handle with care."
Vik (Eng): implementation note: consider offering a "precision" option (6 decimals vs full) to shrink CSV size. also include an optional checksum column if helpful.
Uma (A11y): small addition: example headers toggle should be a button with aria-expanded, and the example code block should be focusable. I'll write acceptance criteria shortly.
yui-support-bot: reminder scheduled: design review on 2026-04-03 15:00 UTC.
Tess (Design): thanks all 680 will update Figma and add the example headers collapsed. action items: Vik to spec export formats & estimates; Uma to post a11y checklist; Xia to write QA tests; Willa to draft support blurb. Ping here if blockers.
